title: Testing and QA
meta: Manual and automated testing of every feature so your release is solid, with a clear bug report. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Testing and QA before you release
overview: We test your web app the way real users would. We write a list of what to check, go through every feature on desktop and mobile browsers, record each problem with screenshots and steps to reproduce, and rank them by how much they matter. For the bigger packages we also write automated tests, so the next release can be checked in minutes rather than days.

pkgs.blurb: Manual testing of the main flows with a bug report.
Wider testing across browsers, with a reusable test plan.
Manual and automated tests, plus speed and accessibility checks.

faq: Do you fix the bugs you find?
In these packages we find and report them. Fixing is a separate order, such as our bug fixing service, or your own developers can use the report. We can quote fixes after we see the list.
Yes, ideally one for each role in your app, such as customer and admin, on a test or staging copy. We never test on live customer accounts, and we avoid real payments.
Can you test a site that is not live yet?
Yes, and that is the best time. Share a staging link and login. We test before launch so users do not find the problems first.
We check obvious things, like whether one user can open another's data, but this is not a security audit. For deeper checks, see the security services on our site.
